figures.name: Tengri (Kazakh)

ability.name: Steppe Sky
ability.description: Grant all steppe-domain cards +4 power; the vast sky has no boundaries.

figures.description: The supreme sky deity as revered by the Kazakh people, the eternal blue sky whose vastness mirrors the endless steppe.

figures.name: Umai (Kazakh)

ability.name: Hearth Mother
ability.description: Protect all allied cards; the hearth fire cannot be extinguished for 2 turns.

figures.description: The mother goddess of the Kazakhs, protector of children and hearth, whose sacred fire must never be allowed to go out in the yurt.

figures.name: Erklik (Kazakh)

ability.name: Winter Death
ability.description: Freeze all enemy cards; they lose 2 speed and cannot use heating abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Kazakh lord of the underworld, similar to Erlik, who rules the frozen lower realm and sends cold and death into the world.

figures.name: Kozy-Korpesh

ability.name: Betrothed Bond
ability.description: Form an unbreakable bond with one allied card; both share damage and healing equally.

figures.description: The hero of the great Kazakh epic of tragic love, betrothed from birth to Bayan-Sulu, whose story ends in death and transformation.

figures.name: Bayan-Sulu

ability.name: Faithful Love
ability.description: If your partner card is destroyed, gain +4 to all stats from grief; avenge the loss.

figures.description: The beautiful heroine of the Kazakh epic, faithful to her betrothed Kozy-Korpesh, whose love story became the greatest Kazakh romance.

figures.name: Alpamys

ability.name: Hero's Return
ability.description: Return from seemingly impossible odds; if reduced to 1 HP, recover to 50% next turn.

figures.description: The great hero of the Kazakh epic Alpamys, whose extraordinary strength and archery allow him to save his people after years of captivity.

figures.name: Koblandy Batyr

ability.name: Steppe Charge
ability.description: Charge across the steppe; deal 9 damage to one enemy and disrupt their entire formation.

figures.description: The legendary Kazakh batyr (hero) who fought to protect his people from enemies, one of the greatest warriors of the Kazakh epic tradition.

figures.name: Er Targyn

ability.name: Elder's Peace
ability.description: Negotiate an end to one conflict; stop all combat for 1 turn and restore 3 HP to all.

figures.description: The elder hero of Kazakh tradition who uses wisdom rather than force, whose counsel prevents wars and saves his people.

figures.name: Baksy (Shaman)

ability.name: Spirit Drum
ability.description: Journey to the spirit world; retrieve one lost ability and bring it back into play.

figures.description: The Kazakh shaman who beats a drum to travel between worlds, healing illness by retrieving lost souls from the spirit realm.

figures.name: Jetibar

ability.name: Seven Heads
ability.description: Attack seven times in one turn at reduced power; each head strikes a different target.

figures.description: The seven-headed dragon of Kazakh folklore who must be defeated by the hero, representing the ultimate challenge of the epic quest.

figures.name: Aydahar

ability.name: Dragon's Hoard
ability.description: Steal 3 resources from the enemy; they cannot use those resources until reclaimed.

figures.description: The great serpentine dragon of Kazakh mythology, an evil creature that must be overcome by the epic heroes.

figures.name: Zhetysu

ability.name: Seven Rivers Land
ability.description: Bless the homeland; all allied cards on the field gain 3 HP from the fertile land.

figures.description: The spirit of the Seven Rivers land, the ancestral homeland of the Kazakhs in what is now Kazakhstan, whose abundance sustains the people.

figures.name: Saryarka

ability.name: Golden Steppe
ability.description: Freedom of the steppe; all allied cards can move to any position freely for 1 turn.

figures.description: The spirit of the golden steppe, the vast Kazakh heartland whose endless grasslands have shaped the nomadic culture and identity.

figures.name: Konyr Ata

ability.name: Herd Blessing
ability.description: All livestock and animal-domain cards gain +2 to all stats; the ancestral cattle prosper.

figures.description: The ancestor spirit protector of cattle and herds, essential to the nomadic Kazakh economy, propitiated before migrations.

figures.name: Aq Shamal

ability.name: White Wind Message
ability.description: Deliver information instantly; look at the opponent's hand and choose one card to reveal.

figures.description: The white wind spirit who carries messages across the steppe, associated with good news and the swift travel of the nomadic people.

figures.name: Threshold Witch

ability.name: Threshold Test
ability.description: Test one allied card; if they pass the wisdom check, they gain +3 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: The boundary witch figure in Kazakh tradition who tests heroes and provides them with magical gifts or sends them to their doom.

figures.name: Kyz-Zhibek

ability.name: Love Song
ability.description: Your song reaches across all distance; reconnect with any previously separated ally card.

figures.description: The beautiful heroine of the Kazakh epic Kyz-Zhibek, whose love story ends in tragedy, one of the most beloved Kazakh romantic epics.

figures.name: Tolegen

ability.name: Journey for Love
ability.description: Travel to any zone; appear where most needed regardless of distance.

figures.description: The young hero who journeys to win Kyz-Zhibek's love in the Kazakh epic, but whose tragic fate prevents their union.

figures.name: Qorqyt Ata

ability.name: Kobyz Song
ability.description: Play the kobyz to freeze death itself; prevent one card from being destroyed for 2 turns.

figures.description: The legendary Kazakh shaman-bard who invented the kobyz instrument and tried to escape death by traveling the world, whose music could freeze the grim reaper.

figures.name: Shamshi Qazaq

ability.name: Steppe Freedom
ability.description: Resist all foreign control; allied cards cannot be converted or controlled by enemy abilities.

figures.description: A legendary Kazakh hero of resistance, representing the spirit of national independence and the refusal to submit to foreign domination.
